div.div:
SparkXGBRegressor × 7
objective = reg:quantileerror (pinball loss)
quantile_alpha ∈ {0.50, 0.60, 0.70, 0.80, 0.85, 0.90, 0.95}
n_estimators=best_round (~43 typical, range 40–53) · η=0.15 · max_depth=8
subsample=0.8 · colsample_bytree=0.8 · min_child_weight=20

div.div:
Driver-side 1% Sample — Elbow Detection
local xgb.train() × 7 (throwaway, full xgb_num_round)
Same hyperparams + evals_result={};
Elbow = round where Δloss < 0.3% of total gain
best_round = min(int(elbow × 1.5) + 1, xgb_num_round)
→ feeds n_estimators of real SparkXGBRegressor
Models discarded — curves + best_round saved only

div.div:
_save_all_precomputed_delays_from_df()
1. Trino: fetch 134 CH district → bpuic mappings
2. ONE Spark pass: join all districts +
groupBy(district_uuid, categoricals) + avg(numerics)
→ write temp HDFS Parquet
3. Read back in batches of 5 districts
4. Batch XGBoost → 134 JSON files

div.div:
ConfidenceEvaluator.route_passes()
1. headway = next_dep − walk − sched_arr
2. P(delay ≤ headway) via linear CDF interp
over 8 anchor pts: (0,0) + (p50..p95)
3. route_confidence = ∏ P(delay_k ≤ headway_k)
4. Accept if route_confidence ≥ confidence_q
